title: Before I Fall
author: Lauren Oliver
summary: Samantha Kingston, a popular high school senior, dies in a car crash on the night of a party. She then wakes up to the same day again and again, and has to work out what to do with it.
readIf: you like emotional teen stories with a time-loop twist about kindness and consequences.
skipIf: you are not up for a heavy story about teen cruelty and death, or want a light read.
